## Enriched image prompt
Create an original pastel, cosy suburban roleplay town with six prebuilt claimable houses. Arrange the houses on quiet residential streets connected to a small, distinct commercial strip, using soft-colored facades, tidy lawns, sidewalks, streetlights, and driveways. Build a connected road network about 20 studs wide throughout, with turning space and parking access suitable for drivable cars. Make each of the six houses enterable from its driveway and keep the residential area visually calmer than the commercial frontage. Use welcoming, polished suburban materials and frame the full road circulation, all house lots, and the commercial district in one readable town plan without copying a named game’s exact locations or assets.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim.

## Shape and preset
Use `settlement-claimable`, a Zone (Claimable Houses), because players claim finished homes rather than construct on empty plots. The preset is Life.

## Config requirements
Use `path-road-vehicle` for a connected road network about 20 studs wide, including driveways and safe turns for cars. Use `district-zoned` to separate six quiet residential lots from the small commercial strip. Use `building-interior` for the six enterable prebuilt houses. Drivable vehicle behavior and house-claim logic are mechanics applied to this geometry.

## Layout requirements
No additional post-segmentation option placement is required. The six claimable properties are concrete house-and-driveway zones defined by the chosen shape, and the prompt does not request NPCs, jobs, or trigger stations.

## Layout components
The town has six prebuilt houses with lawns and driveways, enterable house interiors, one quiet residential district, one small commercial strip, 20-stud-wide connected roads, sidewalks, parking access, streetlights, and soft landscaped edges. Every driveway connects cleanly to the road loop. Outer streets and greenery form the map boundary.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: make the plan authoritative so the 20-stud vehicle roads, turns, driveways, and six lots connect cleanly, then dress the isometric view from it.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is large because a small town, six houses, and vehicle roads must fit while doors and driveways remain legible. The theme is pastel, cosy contemporary suburbia. The modifier is `P3` because players move between the town exterior and six house interiors.
